snippet.title: Letter Lost - Official Gameplay Trailer | Dames 4 Games Halloween Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Get a closer look at the creepy world of Letter Lost in this trailer for the upcoming work sim meets escape room/horror game. As the sole employee of the Kharnym post office you’ll stamp, sort, and deliver the mail to the residents of the island. But what they won’t tell you is there’s more to this job than meets the eye and the office itself holds secrets you’ll need to uncover. This may be the only job you’ll ever need to work… unless of course you can escape. Letter Lost will be available on PC in 2025.
